cs.t: I'm the only person at my company who asked for a Linux machine. And I got it. Everyone else is on an M1. I said no. I don't want to use a Mac ever again. I had a Mac for 2 years at my previous company, one of those 2018 monstrousities. Never again. I asked for a P14 AMD Ryzen 7 5850H ThinkPad. Its still en route. But until then I'm using my Dell G5 SE Ryzen 7 4800H laptop with Manjaro. Best dev experience I've ever had at a company. The dev machine adds to the package IMO. If you're not getting the tools you want, you're not being paid enough ever.
cs.th: Docker Desktop no longer free for large companies
